tickets.name: Out of the Huddle
tickets.note: Pull up a chair for Cavaliers at Knicks, because the first minute is where the money is! Towns has to deal with Allen in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! Win that tip and the Cavaliers are first in line to score. Should Allen get the tip, the ball comes right back to him. First look, baby! If that first look rims out, Watson is right there to clean it up!

tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: Celtics at Raptors, and here's how we see the opening act! The jump ball goes Poeltl against Queta, and Poeltl has the springs tonight! That hands the Raptors the first possession, and that's half the battle! If Poeltl controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! And Murray-Boyles is the backup plan on that possession, a fine backup plan at that! If the Celtics steal the tip or get the first stop, Queta is who we want firing first!

tickets.name: Lead the Break

This opening could break either way, and we know which way we're leaning! If Davis wins that tip, he goes right back to work, and he's the first look!

tickets.name: First Touch
tickets.note: It's Nuggets and Grizzlies, and buddy, we've got a plan for the opening act! It starts with Edey against Jokic at center court, and our money says Edey gets up there first! Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Nuggets! Tip it, run it, finish it. If Jokic gets that jump, that's the whole plan! Gordon is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! And Johnson sneaks in as the third man, just in case!

And if the Pelicans flip the script, Matkovic is waiting right there to pounce!
